# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `rillet` MCP server pointing at Rillet's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api.rillet.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.0 with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE against `api.rillet.com`, with the `read` and `write` scopes.
- Logo: Rillet's official app icon, the 512×512 web clip published on rillet.com, resized to 256×256.
